title: Phase 1 IAM Check Metadata
description: Schema for every metadata.json accompanying a Phase 1 IAM rule. Every field is mandatory unless marked optional.

SeverityBasis.description: Explicit grounding of the severity assignment in an authoritative source or the framework's severity classification model.

AuthoritativeSource.description: Primary source(s) only: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, AWS Security Hub FSBP, AWS official documentation, NIST SP 800-53/800-162/800-63. Secondary sources belong in ThreatReference.

CISControl.description: Either a CIS AWS 3.0.0 control identifier (e.g., 'CIS AWS 3.0.0 - 1.7 (Level 1)') or an explicit 'N/A — <reason>' string.

NISTControl.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control identifier(s), e.g., 'NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 - AC-6, CM-5'.

ThreatReference.description: Optional secondary threat-intelligence reference (MITRE ATT&CK, security research). Must NOT appear in AuthoritativeSource.

then.description: Secondary sources (Rhino Security Labs, CloudGoat, MITRE ATT&CK) must not appear in AuthoritativeSource — move them to ThreatReference.
The phrase 'aligns with' is not permitted in CISControl — use explicit 'N/A — <reason>' or a numbered control identifier.
